blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — An alleged high-value drug trafficker known as “Boss Dexter” was arrested after yielding P374,000 worth of suspected crystal meth and a loaded handgun during a police sting operation in Tubod town, Lanao del Norte, on Wednesday morning, Nov. 11. The 43-year-old local resident was cornered by operatives of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit (RPDEU-10) and local police in Barangay Poblacion at around 9:25 a.m., according to a press advisory released on Thursday by the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) based in this city.
